description: Role-aware inference monitoring. Workers are discovered at refresh. Gauges show snapshots; rates use consecutive-scrape deltas. Additive counts use stacked lines; ratios and latency stay separate.

spec.title: Scrape health
spec.description: Current instance scrape targets, discovered from live labels. Expected counts depend on the actual number of engine workers; no fixed six-target baseline.

spec.title: Prefill - Request queue time p50/p95
spec.description: Per-request wait before first scheduling in this engine instance, from the native queue-time histogram; separate from instance processing time. p50/p95 are histogram estimates for observations recorded between the latest consecutive scrapes, with reset handling. These completion-accounted observations are not timers for currently unfinished requests. No observations means no percentile; coarse buckets limit precision. Quantiles are computed separately per pod, never summed or stacked.

spec.title: Prefill - GPU utilization
spec.description: Scoped to prefill; the Role selector filters this section.

spec.title: Prefill - GPU memory used
spec.description: Scoped to prefill; the Role selector filters this section.

spec.title: Prefill - KV block hit ratio (sample interval)
spec.description: For each point: reused block delta / (reused + missed block deltas) over matching consecutive scrape samples, by DP rank. Excludes lifetime history. An idle zero denominator is undefined, not zero. Each point uses the latest consecutive-scrape counter deltas, with reset handling, before combining series. The 1m range only finds two samples; it does not average them across a minute. The actual elapsed scrape interval determines the per-second value.

spec.title: Prefill - GPU KV active-block utilization

spec.title: Prefill - GPU KV active / available blocks

Separate query categories have separate stack groups, so active and available are not added to each other. Does not report host or SSD occupancy.

spec.title: Running engines missing telemetry

spec.expr: count((max by(namespace,pod)(kube_pod_init_container_info{namespace="$namespace",pod=~"@@ENGINE_PODS@@",container="@@ENGINE_CONTAINER@@"} or kube_pod_container_info{namespace="$namespace",pod=~"@@ENGINE_PODS@@",container="@@ENGINE_CONTAINER@@"}) and on(namespace,pod) max by(namespace,pod)(kube_pod_status_phase{namespace="$namespace",pod=~"@@ENGINE_PODS@@",phase="Running"} == 1)) unless on(namespace,pod) (up{namespace="$namespace",job=~"@@METRIC_JOBS@@",endpoint="@@ENGINE_ENDPOINT@@",pod=~"@@ENGINE_PODS@@"} == 1)) or vector(0)

Normal line stacking adds instance/rank contributions at the same timestamp; it does not accumulate over time. spec.title: Frontend TTFT - p50/p95 estimates
spec.description: Estimated percentiles of frontend time-to-first-token observations between the latest two scrapes. These are not individual request latencies. The source histogram has coarse buckets: a sparse set near the bottom of a bucket can yield a percentile estimate near its upper bound. The highest finite boundary can also cap estimates for overflow observations. Better percentile precision requires finer source buckets; latest-request values or averages are different statistics and are not substitutes.

spec.title: Request-trace volume used / free
spec.description: Kubelet-reported disk usage for the request-trace PVC holding frontend gzip trace segments. Segments rotate at 64 MiB but the sink never prunes old files, so used bytes only grow; a steady slope is time until the claim fills. Archive and verify before deleting, then prune.

spec.title: Healthy scrape targets
spec.description: Current instance scrape targets, discovered from live labels. Expected counts depend on the actual number of engine workers; no fixed six-target baseline.

spec.title: Frontend end-to-end latency
spec.description: Frontend metrics cover the complete request path and remain visible for every Role selection. spec.title: Frontend requests per second

The actual elapsed scrape interval determines the per-second value.

spec.title: Request-trace volume free
spec.description: Unused fraction of the 20-GiB request-trace PVC. Red means the primary acceptance dump is at risk: the file sink drops records once the claim fills. The used/free trend panel shows the same claim, so archive and verify before it fills.

spec.title: Output tokens per second
spec.description: Live aggregate output token rate from the streaming counter, averaged over the selected rate interval. The counter updates during generation, avoiding completion-time output-length spikes. Each point uses the latest consecutive-scrape counter deltas, with reset handling, before combining series. The 1m range only finds two samples; it does not average them across a minute. The actual elapsed scrape interval determines the per-second value. Normal line stacking adds instance/rank contributions at the same timestamp; it does not accumulate over time. Different query categories use separate stack groups to avoid adding overlapping quantities.

spec.title: Prefill - Physical tier storage states
spec.description: Logical slot bytes, disjoint free/evictable/unavailable states. Retained evictable prefixes occupy storage and may be useful to a later request. Pool groups are byte-weighted; this is not device allocator usage. Reporting-rank coverage can be limited.

spec.title: Prefill - Tier resident occupancy
spec.description: Resident = (unavailable + evictable) / total logical slot bytes at the current sample. High occupancy alone is not proof of thrashing; correlate churn, final drops and recent misses. Missing/zero-capacity observations are undefined, not zero.

spec.title: Prefill - Tier restore / eviction turnover
spec.description: rate(moved bytes) / current capacity, by attributed level. This is capacity turnovers per second and may exceed 1/s. Restore is attributed to the hotter destination; evict to its departing source. Counts reflect accepted submissions, not confirmed DMA.

spec.title: Prefill - Tier capacity / priority drops
spec.description: Final prefix-loss bytes per second, separated by capacity and priority policy. Ordinary request release and explicit cache clearing are excluded. These rate() queries average counter deltas over the configured lookback.

spec.title: Prefill - Sampled restore latency p50/p95
spec.description: Opt-in sampled migration-batch CUDA stream intervals over 5m, bucket-merged across pools per source/destination path. Not per-request restore stall, exclusive GPU busy time, or all-rank latency. Sparse samples limit percentiles. Disabled or pending samples are not zero latency.

spec.title: Prefill - Migration timing samples skipped / s
spec.description: Eligible timing samples skipped while the bounded pending-event budget is full. Zero means no measured skips; absent does not prove that timing is enabled. Permanently pending events can exhaust the sampling budget until teardown.

spec.title: Prefill - Request KV transfer duration p50/p95
spec.description: Completed-request KV-transfer start/end duration, counted once across output candidates. Includes only supplied valid measurements. This is not NIC utilization, sampled migration-batch latency, or necessarily request stall; prefill and decode observations are separate.
